div.div: مَنْظَرَانِىٌّ (S, M, A, K) and ↓ مَنْظَرِىٌّ , (M, K,) the latter contr. to analogy, (M,) A man (M,) of goodly aspect. (M, K.) You say, رَجُلٌ مَنْظَرَانِىٌّ مَخْبَرَانِىٌّ [A man of goodly aspect and of pleasing internal, or intrinsic, qualities]; (S, A;) i. e., ذُو مَنْظَرٍ and ذُو مَخْبَرٍ. (TA, art. خبر.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
